messages:
Jules (CSM): FYI HelixAI renewal lands 30 days out. Procurement pushed back asking about MAU overage protection and whether we can cap billing to seats instead of usage for this term. They want terms and signature path clarified.
Luca (AM): Thanks Jules. Do we have the customer's current SKU breakdown? Last I saw they were on growth + 3 seats, but MAU spiked last month.
Jules (CSM): I attached the usage CSV to the customer record — spike was a one-off integration test. Customer is asking for either a 10% buffer or convert to a seat-based flat charge for this renewal quarter.
Ben (Finance): Seat-based for 3 months is doable as a short-term amendment, but we need prorate calc and approval for the mid-term billing change. Will need PO or CC confirmation.
Marta (Legal): If we move to seat-based for a fixed term, we need to add a clause limiting future true-ups and specifying how overages are handled after the amendment expires. I can draft a short addendum.
Nora (Enablement): If they go seat-based, we should schedule a quick kickoff to ensure they disable the test integration that caused the spike. That avoids surprise overages post-renewal. 15–20 min call should do.
Luca (AM): I'll confirm with the buyer. Can we offer a one-time 10% credit instead of changing terms? That might be faster.
Ben (Finance): A one-time credit is simplest operationally. We can issue credit on the renewal invoice. Need to confirm amount — 10% of the overage or 10% of monthly invoice? Clarify with customer.
Jules (CSM): Customer prefers an explicit seat billing path for predictability. They're pushing procurement to avoid variable billing.
Marta (Legal): Ok — I can prepare a two-paragraph amendment: (1) temporary seat-based billing for 3 months, (2) reversion to usage model with explicit notification 30 days prior, (3) no retroactive refunds aside from agreed credit.
Luca (AM): Great. Once Marta has draft, send to procurement and cc finance. Procurement wants PO # before signature.
Ben (Finance): We'll accept PO. Also will need invoice billing code and VAT details.
Jules (CSM): Procurement asked if DocuSign is acceptable or if they need internal e-sign tool.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope ready when contract is uploaded. Status: waiting_for_sender.
Marta (Legal): DocuSign is fine. I'll attach amendment in the Docusign template and remove any developer-facing language.
Luca (AM): Next steps: Marta drafts amendment today, Ben confirms billing/VAT path, Jules schedules the 20-min enablement call, and I will request PO from procurement. Anyone object?
Ben (Finance): No objections. Will confirm VAT/finance details by EOD.
Nora (Enablement): I'll be available for the call tomorrow 10:30am PT.
Jules (CSM): Perfect — I'll ping the buyer and propose tomorrow 10:30am PT.
Luca (AM): Thanks team. Quick ask: if procurement insists on a net45 workflow, we may need to adjust renewal effective date. I'll flag if that happens.
Marta (Legal): Drafting now. Will upload to DocuSign by 16:00 PT.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope sent to buyer@example.com at 16:05 PT.
Jules (CSM): Buyer signed at 17:12 PT — forwarding PO now. :tada:
Ben (Finance): Got PO 987654 — will route to billing and confirm invoice schedule.
Luca (AM): Closing the loop: amendment applied, seat-billing for 3 months, PO captured, enablement call done, legal and finance aligned. Great teamwork. :white_check_mark:
